audit_phase: Phase 3 Autonomous Engineering Core Execution & Hardening

agents.limitations: The 13 agents exist as declarative Pydantic schemas. POST /agents/dispatch logs an audit event and records a static TaskItem without spawning an autonomous agentic tool-execution loop.

tools.limitations: Specialized micro-tools (pytest runner, regex secret scan, cost evaluator, host telemetry) are fully executable. Complex agent tools (AST search, dynamic component generator, refactor engine) are declarative string labels.

approvals.limitations: Policy engine blocks HIGH/CRITICAL actions. Replay protection is enforced. Authentication is missing on the HTTP decision endpoint.

cli.limitations: All 13 subcommands (status, projects, agents, audit, test, security, deploy, approvals, brief, cost, secrets, jobs, traces, docs, logs) reach the live Control API.

automation.limitations: Jobs execute as application functions with manual triggers via API/CLI. Zero jobs are scheduled in Cloud Scheduler or local crontab.

providers.limitations: Adapters for Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic are interface stubs that return mock dictionaries. External API keys are intentionally excluded to enforce zero-cost policy.

github.limitations: Reads repository path, current branch, latest commit, and uncommitted changes via real git subprocesses. Creating pull requests, diffs, or remote branches via API is not implemented.

observability.limitations: Live psutil telemetry streamed over WebSocket /ws. Trace IDs, request correlation IDs, latency rolling buffers, and JSON structured logs operational. Agent execution metric recording is partial.

cicd.limitations: Stages 1-6 (lint, type check, unit tests, integration tests, secret scan, policy check) and stage 12 (rollback) are implemented. Stages 7-11 are configured with keyless WIF but standby awaiting billing enablement.

security.limitations: Secret masking, zero static keys, least-privilege IAM, and approval replay protection verified. API endpoints currently lack token authentication and CORS wildcard credentials should be restricted.

tests.limitations: 33/33 unit and integration tests passing in 10.14s. Tests verify local FastAPI schemas, policy rules, approvals, cost guardrails, and secret masking. Zero external cloud API calls are made.
